protocol.candidate_definition: First K unique complete codes from effective_codes; candidate_limit=10 for both variants
protocol.effective_candidate_policy: Unverified expanded spectrum only for unsupported predicted layouts; otherwise validated spectrum
protocol.feature_difference: B appends a trained input-only Char-CNN embedding; identical TF-IDF, structured features, tree types/parameters/blends, labels, retrieval, rules, attributes and router
protocol.tree_selection: Frozen A training-only grouped OOF; no B OOF claims and no transferred confidence calibration
protocol.displayed_slot_definition: First displayed strict spectrum hypothesis; unknown decoded fields remain unknown
protocol.joint_slot_at_k_definition: Truth slot value occurs among the first K effective complete-code candidates
protocol.marginal_at_k_definition: Independent slot alternatives; not joint full-code coverage
protocol.unmapped_details: Detailed labels unavailable; these rows remain in full-code all/unmapped denominators
protocol.evaluation_status: Previously inspected final diagnostic set; not an untouched blind test
